cardio.title: Cardio Test
cardio.subtitle: Cardio axis uses Cooper only; 5 km is specialty-only.
cardio.cooperWorldRecordCapHint: Distance exceeds model ceiling ({{capMeters}} m). Scoring uses capped distance.

cooperInfo.bubbleTip: Run hard for 12 minutes and log total distance (meters). Prefer a track or GPS route.
cooperInfo.bubbleReferenceHint: Full details are in “{{title}}” at the bottom.
cooperInfo.title: Cooper 12-Minute Run Test
cooperInfo.p1: 12-minute maximal-distance field test (Dr. Kenneth H. Cooper lineage). Fitness context only — not medical diagnosis.
cooperInfo.p2: Use a track or flat route; count laps or GPS meters. Warm up 10–15 minutes before the test.
cooperInfo.p3: Score maps sex and age to norm distance tables. Cooper band from age 13+.
cooperInfo.p4: Norm distances follow published Cooper chart lineage; this app uses the reference anchor table.
cooperInfo.p5: Model ceilings: 4900 m (male), 4400 m (female); scores cap above.

cardio.run5kmWorldRecordFloorHint: Time is faster than the model floor ({{capTime}}). Scoring uses the capped time.

run5kmInfo.title: 5 km Finish-Time Test
run5kmInfo.p1: Specialty optional — local + ladder only; never enters the six-axis cardio score. Fitness context only.
run5kmInfo.p3: Faster than the 100-pt anchor uses linear + quartic overflow. Missing sex defaults to male norms.
run5kmInfo.p4: Never falls back into the six-axis radar.
run5kmInfo.p5: Model floors: {{maleFloor}} (male), {{femaleFloor}} (female); scores cap when faster.

cardio.nextMilestoneHint: Next Milestone: {{points}} pts until next tier upgrade.
cardio.profileIncompleteHint: Cooper needs age and sex on Home. 5 km specialty still accepts time.
